shell.tagline: Every day can start with a plan.
shell.description: Discover people, activities and new reasons to get out and explore.

signIn.title: What's the plan today?
signIn.description: Sign in and discover plans, getaways and experiences near you.

errors.required: Enter your username or email and password.
errors.usernameSpaces: The username or email cannot contain spaces.
errors.invalidCredentials: The username, email or password is incorrect.
errors.generic: We couldn't sign you in. Please try again.

signUp.title: Create your account.
signUp.description: A name, an email and a reason to find your next plan.
signUp.invitationHint: Outfy is currently in private development.

errors.generic: We couldn't create the account. Please try again.

verifyEmail.title: Check your email.
verifyEmail.description: We've sent you a verification code to confirm that this email belongs to you.
verifyEmail.newCodeSent: We've sent you a new code.

errors.invalidEmail: Enter the email used to create your account.
errors.verifyGeneric: We couldn't verify your email. Please try again.

forgotPassword.title: Forgot your password?
forgotPassword.description: Enter the email address you used to create your account and we'll send you a link to choose a new password.
forgotPassword.success: If an account exists for that email address, you'll receive a link to reset your password.

errors.rateLimit: You've requested too many links. Please wait a while before trying again.
errors.generic: We couldn't send the email. Please try again.

resetPassword.title: Create a new password
resetPassword.description: Choose a new password to access your Outfy account again.
resetPassword.successDescription: You can now sign in with your new password.

errors.invalidLink: This recovery link is invalid or has expired. Request a new one.
errors.passwordTooShort: Your password must be at least 8 characters long.
errors.samePassword: Your new password can't be the same as your current password. Choose a different one.
errors.weakPassword: Your password doesn't meet the security requirements. Choose a stronger password.
errors.generic: We couldn't change your password. Please try again.
